_llm_instructions: Fill out the 'project_title', 'date_prepared' properties, and generate an array of activity objects for the 'Activity List' table based on the context. Context: The activity list defines all the activities necessary to complete the project work. It also describes the activities in sufficient detail so that the person performing the work understands the requirements necessary to complete it correctly. The activity list is an output from process 6.2 Define Activities in the PMBOK® Guide – Sixth Edition.

Activity List.guidance: Generate a JSON array of activity objects representing the work breakdown.
